title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2610.37657v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-b

translated_title: 安全之头：学习型注意力门控提升提示注入鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Heads of Security（HoS），这是一种通过一小组学习得到的逐头注意力门控来强制实现指令-数据分离的提示注入防御方法。HoS学习每个注意力头应如何在受信任与不受信任的token之间重新分配注意力，使模型能够对不受信任的内容进行推理，同时不会遵循注入的指令。我们在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct和GPT-OSS-20B上评估了HoS，并将其与SecAlign++（一种最先进的基于微调的防御方法）以及ASIDE（一种与我们的方法类似、将指令-数据分离内建于模型架构中的防御方法）进行比较。结果表明，HoS对自适应攻击具有更强的鲁棒性，在标准效用基准上表现更好，并在标准智能体提示注入基准上达到顶尖性能。更具体而言，黑盒攻击RL-Hammer对GPT-OSS-20B的攻击成功率（ASR）达到97%，对SecAlign达到85%，但对HoS仅为10%。
tldr: 提出Heads of Security（HoS）防御方法，通过为每个注意力头学习注意力门控来实现指令与数据的分离，使模型能在处理不可信内容时不执行注入指令，相比现有防御方法显著提升了对自适应提示注入攻击的鲁棒性并保持模型效用。
en_tdlr: Heads of Security (HoS) enforces instruction-data separation through learned per-head attention gates, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions and achieving far greater robustness to adaptive prompt injection attacks than existing defenses while maintaining strong utility.
